score_target: median stressor-held-out channel R2 relative to outer-training channel means
split_target: mean family transfer on named training/held-out sets; descriptive difference
split_evaluation_unit: named synthetic family; fixed split, not iid family draws
selected_pipeline_optimism_status: pending; independent evaluation of the full selection pipeline required
bound_target: candidate population optimality gap under the declared simulator distribution
bound_resampling_unit: independent reference family set; one gap per reference solution
bound_method: basic bootstrap upper bound on clipped reference sample-optimum gaps
bound_coverage_status: nominal approximation, not empirically coverage-calibrated or distribution-free
